tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Registrar/Chief Engineer, ACIWRM, 1st floor, KSFC Bhavan, #1/1 Thimmaiah Road, Bengaluru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka. The Consultant should not be blacklisted or debarred by any Central/State Government, Multilateral Funding Agency, or Public Sector Undertaking in India as on date of bid submission. Supporting Document: Self-declaration undertaking on official letterhead signed by the authorized signatory.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 202.08 Lakh in any of last 2 years in the last 5 financial years (FY 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) from consulting services (from India business). Additional weightage at 10% for each year will be added to the financial turnover to bring it to the 2026-27 price level.

The Consultant must have completed at least one (01) assessment / technical evaluation / baseline or endline study in irrigation, water resources, or agriculture sectors for a Government agency, PSU, external funding agency (e.g., World Bank, ADB, JICA) or under CSR activities in the last 5 financial years (FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26). Supporting Document: Work Completion Certificate / Work Order along with formal completion sign-off issued by the Competent Authority / Authorized Signatory of the respective client organization (or an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer / Equivalent in case of Government / PSU clients).

Satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) at least One (01) assignment involving Impact Assessment, Performance Evaluation, Baseline/Endline Studies, or Technical Diagnostic Studies in the Irrigation, Water Resources, Canal Modernization, Agriculture, or Watershed sectors in India, during the last five financial years (FY 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26). The consultancy fee for each of these completed assignments must be not less than Rs. 50.52 Lakh.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Specific experience in conducting Impact Assessment, Diagnostic Studies or Performance Evaluation of Major/Medium/Minor Irrigation / Watershed / Agriculture / Command Area Development projects involving assessments of water delivery, crop productivity, farm economics, or participatory institutions in the last 5 financial years (5 marks per completed study, maximum 10 marks)

Experience in conducting large-scale socioeconomic/agricultural field surveys (covering more than 500 farmers/command areas) in water resources/irrigation sectors/agriculture (5 marks per project, max 10 marks)
Understanding of the project scope, NLBC command area dynamics, and technical objectives (hydraulic, agricultural, SCADA, institutional)
Technical methodology: Hydraulic/SCADA data validation, remote sensing & GIS analytics workflow, and socioeconomic sampling design
Work plan, task scheduling, resource mobilization timeline, and quality assurance framework for primary field surveys

Project Director / Team Leader (1 No.). Educational Qualification: Postgraduate with 20 years or Graduate with 25 years of experience in Civil Engineering, Water Resources, Irrigation, Hydrology, Watershed Management, or related water domains. Experience: The expert must have a minimum of 20 (Postgraduate)/25 (Graduate) years of overall professional experience, including 8 plus years of demonstrated leadership experience in managing projects, impact assessments, or performance studies in the irrigation, watershed, or broader water sector

Irrigation / Water Management Expert (1 No.). Educational Qualification: Degree or Master's in Agricultural Engineering, Civil Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, or Irrigation Management. Experience: Minimum 8 years of professional experience in canal water distribution, command area management, on-farm irrigation management, flow regulation, crop water demand & water budgeting.

Remote Sensing & GIS Expert (1 No.). Educational Qualification: Master's in Geoinformatics / Remote Sensing / GIS / Earth Sciences. Experience: Minimum 6 years of experience in remote sensing applications to water resources management/agriculture management, crop area mapping, ET/irrigation monitoring, and processing satellite/drone data

Agricultural Economist (1 No.). Educational Qualification: Master's/PhD in Agricultural Economics / Economics / Applied Economics. Experience: Minimum 6 years of experience in crop productivity analysis, farm income assessment, and cost-benefit evaluations in cultivated areas.

Social Scientist (1 No.). Educational Qualification: Master's in Sociology / Social Work / Rural Development / Public Policy. Experience: Minimum 6 years of experience in Water User Association (WUA) assessments, institutional diagnostics, and participatory rural appraisals.

Data Analyst (1 No.). Educational Qualification: Degree in Engineering / Statistics / Data Science / Computer Science. Experience: Minimum 4 years of experience in time-series data analytics, database management, and hydrological data processing.
